title: Wonders of Vietnam Sapa and the Bay
alt: Terraced rice fields on the hillsides around Sa Pa
transport: Private transfers, a mountain cable car and a cruise boat

program.name: Hanoi

stops.name: Sa Pa

activities.name: Cat Cat village walk
activities.description: A half day on foot down into Cat Cat, a Black Hmong village of terraced fields, water wheels and a waterfall below Sa Pa.

activities.name: Fansipan mountain tour
activities.description: The cable car up Fansipan, the highest peak in Indochina, to the shrines and the viewing platform at the summit.

program.name: Sa Pa
program.description: Up into the northern hills for the terraced fields of Cat Cat village and the cable car to the top of Fansipan.

program.name: Halong Bay

day_titles.2: Into the hills at Sa Pa

1: Arrival at Noi Bai airport and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your hotel in the old quarter
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: an evening walk around Hoan Kiem lake
2: Breakfast and check out, then north into the hills
Check in at Sa Pa in the afternoon
A half day on foot down into Cat Cat village
Terraced fields, water wheels and a waterfall
3: Breakfast, then the cable car up Fansipan
The shrines and the viewing platform at the summit
Back down and the long run to Hanoi

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Six days and you still get the hills and the bay. It is a lot of road, but the two landscapes are worth it.
expert.tip: Sa Pa is cold and often in cloud from December to February. Take a warm layer even if Hanoi is humid when you land.

summary: Six days in the north: a night in Hanoi, then up to Sa Pa for the terraced fields of Cat Cat village and the cable car to the summit of Fansipan, an overnight cruise among the limestone islands of Halong Bay, and two last nights in the city.
included: Included: 5 nights with breakfast and dinner at the hotels, one of them on a cruise boat with lunch and dinner; private transfers throughout; a half day walk to Cat Cat village; the Fansipan mountain tour with the cable car; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
